citations.claim: Incoming speed just before ceiling contact is ~14.99 upward
One step later outgoing speed is 35.08 downward, far larger than e=0.7 allows (~10.5)
System energy jumps from ~219.8 J to 722.7 J at the bounce, violating the bound

counterfactual.change: Lowered initial vy from 17.16 to 5.0 so the body never reaches the ceiling in 626 steps; no contact means no energy injection and the run passes.

explanation: With no walls, controller off and work=0, the only energy change can come from the arena ceiling bounce at step 625->626. Incoming vy ~+14.99 becomes vy ~-35.08 despite e=0.7 (expected ~-10.5), injecting ~500 J. Setting e=0 still rebounds at ~-24.6 instead of ~0, so restitution is not the cause; the ceiling contact impulse/positional correction itself adds energy (wrong sign or correction counted as velocity).
vision_note: The blue circle stays in contact with the top edge of the arena through steps 623 to 625 and then appears slightly lower in step 626, indicating a ceiling contact and downward rebound. There are no walls, waypoints, or other bodies visible, and no obvious tunneling or large jump.
